array.string: BOOT=$(/usr/sbin/sysctl -n kern.boottime | /usr/bin/sed -E 's/^\{ sec = ([0-9]+),.*/\1/') FLAG="$HOME/Library/Application Support/ClipSave/user-quit" if [ -f "$FLAG" ] && [ "$(/bin/cat "$FLAG")" = "$BOOT" ]; then exit 0; fi /usr/bin/pgrep -x ClipSave >/dev/null && exit 0 for APP in /Applications/ClipSave.app "$HOME/Applications/ClipSave.app"; do if [ -d "$APP" ]; then exec /usr/bin/open -g "$APP"; fi done exit 0
